reuse.why: Keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold, but edits the worst-case expression in place at each site instead of introducing (or using) one shared expected-amount function.

duplication.why: The same new rule (amount - threshold for approx, Math.min for ranges) is written out three times, in api-models.ts, forecast-schedules.ts and shared/schedules.ts.

placement.why: Each edit is where the old expression was, but a rule shared by three consumers belongs in one function in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and its tests; the forecast change also switches ranged amounts from the midpoint to the minimum, which widens the touched behaviour beyond the copies that already used the worst case.

maintainability.why: The next change to the rule again needs three coordinated edits, and the copies already drifted once (forecast used a midpoint).

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared expected-amount helper exists in the tree to go around; the diff simply does not create one.

disguised_duplication.where: The three copies are textually the same nested ternary, openly duplicated rather than disguised.
